plaatsen.tekst: When Saul heard that David was discovered, and the men that were with him, (now Saul abode in Gibeah under a tree in Ramah, having his spear in his hand, and all his servants were standing about him;)
And they took their bones, and buried them under a tree at Jabesh, and fasted seven days.
And Abraham planted a grove in Beersheba, and called there on the name of the LORD, the everlasting God.
